name: rear leg hook kick
description: A martial arts kick with the back leg that swings in an arc to strike with the heel, training hip mobility and control.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Shift your weight onto the lead foot.
Lift the rear knee and extend the leg across the target.
Hook the heel around in an arc.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.
